description: Declared overlap rules for the NUAA manifests of M2. Each manifest is declared with its expected number of rows and SHA-256 (as written by `nuaa_manifests.py build`); a different or truncated manifest stops the check. Severity 'must': a failure makes check-overlap exit with code 1. Severity 'report': the overlap is allowed and only reported. Derivation rules (spread_partition, equals_spread, subject_closure) compare keys with those derived from a source manifest. Dimensions: key (real/<name> or attack/<name>), hash (SHA-256 of the file content), subject (4-digit subject id), subject_session (subject id and 5th field of the file name).

rules.description: no manifest lists the same key twice or the same image content (file SHA-256) under two keys
the validation (early-stopping) images share no image and no subject with the images that fitted the weights
the M1 dev set shares no image and no subject with the images that fitted the weights

no training, validation (early-stopping) or dev image appears in any test manifest, by key or content hash; the (subject, session) part holds by construction of the NUAA protocol (sessions 01-02 vs 03) and is kept for the other datasets
known limit: NUAA is not subject-disjoint between the official train and test splits (different capture session); shared subjects are reported
CNN training, validation (early-stopping) and dev images all belong to the official training split
every validation (early-stopping) image is in the M1 dev set (declared reuse)
declared reuse: 493 of the M1 dev images were the validation images of the CNNs (early stopping, best-epoch selection, learning-rate reduction)
C1 and the CNN test images belong to the official test split
the 300 C1 images are a subset of the 3,000 test images of the checkpoint cards
CNN train and validation are disjoint and together equal spread(official train, 1500) per class (the 3,000 sampled training images)
the M1 dev set is exactly the official training images of the validation subjects
the CNN test images are exactly spread(official test, 1500) per class
the C1 images are exactly spread(official test, 150) per class
